articles.title: Asking Eric: Spouse refuses to ever apologize - AL.com
articles.description: A spouse’s lifelong refusal to admit small mistakes leaves their partner feeling dismissed, resentful, and increasingly worn down by repeated blame-shifting behavior.
articles.content:
Dear Eric: My spouse is unable to say Oops, sorry. He automatically denies having done the thing or blames me or my son even if he literally just did it in front of me/us.
